title: "Assign 16S Taxonomy with SILVA and Cross-check against GTDB"
format:

---

This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/assign_16s_taxonomy.qmd`. SILVA 138.2 is the primary assignment
because the original study used SILVA 138 and comparability matters. GTDB r220
is assigned as a second, independent labelling so that 16S genus names can be
reconciled with the CAT/BAT GTDB lineages already carried by the metagenomic
side of the manuscript. The two are reported side by side; neither is silently
merged into the other.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/assign_16s_taxonomy.qmd [dada2_dir] [reference_dir] [output_dir]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: assign-16s-taxonomy
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
dada2_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DADA2_DIR")
reference_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_REFERENCE_DIR")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 3L) args[[3L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_TAXONOMY_DIR")
if (!nzchar(dada2_dir) || !nzchar(reference_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide dada2_dir, reference_dir and output_dir, or source config/16s_analysis_paths.sh first.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("dada2", quietly = TRUE)) abort("Package dada2 is required.")

threads <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_THREADS", "4"))
min_boot <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_MIN_BOOT", "80"))
set.seed(20260901L)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

seqtab_path <- file.path(dada2_dir, "16s_seqtab_nochim.rds")
if (!file.exists(seqtab_path)) abort("Missing %s. Run scripts/run_16s_dada2.qmd first.", seqtab_path)
seqtab <- readRDS(seqtab_path)
sequences <- dada2::getSequences(seqtab)

reference_path <- function(filename) {
  path <- file.path(reference_dir, filename)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    abort("Missing reference %s. Run scripts/fetch_16s_reference_databases.sh first.", path)
  }
  path
}

# Each reference is assigned once and cached. A k-mer index for SILVA nr99 is
# several gigabytes, so on a small machine the two references must not be
# resident together: run this notebook twice and each pass gets a clean heap.
silva_cache <- file.path(output_dir, "16s_taxonomy_silva_raw.rds")
gtdb_cache <- file.path(output_dir, "16s_taxonomy_gtdb_raw.rds")

if (file.exists(silva_cache)) {
  cat("Loading cached SILVA 138.2 assignment\n")
  silva_cached <- readRDS(silva_cache)
  silva_taxa <- silva_cached$tax
  silva_boot <- silva_cached$boot
  rm(silva_cached)
} else {
  cat(sprintf("Assigning SILVA 138.2 taxonomy to %d ASVs (minBoot = %d)\n",
              length(sequences), min_boot))
  silva <- dada2::assignTaxonomy(
    seqtab, reference_path("silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz"),
    minBoot = min_boot, multithread = threads, outputBootstraps = TRUE
  )
  silva_taxa <- dada2::addSpecies(
    silva$tax, reference_path("silva_v138.2_assignSpecies.fa.gz"))
  silva_boot <- silva$boot
  saveRDS(list(tax = silva_taxa, boot = silva_boot), silva_cache)
  rm(silva)
}
invisible(gc(full = TRUE))

# The GTDB cross-check is secondary. Where it does not fit in memory, the run
# proceeds on SILVA alone and says so in the concordance table rather than
# failing the whole step.
gtdb_enabled <- tolower(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_GTDB_CROSSCHECK", "true")) %in%
  c("true", "1", "yes")
if (!gtdb_enabled) {
  cat("GTDB r220 cross-check disabled by PHAGE_UV_16S_GTDB_CROSSCHECK.\n")
  gtdb_taxa <- NULL
} else if (file.exists(gtdb_cache)) {
  cat("Loading cached GTDB r220 assignment\n")
  gtdb_taxa <- readRDS(gtdb_cache)
} else {
  cat("Assigning GTDB r220 cross-check taxonomy\n")
  gtdb_taxa <- dada2::assignTaxonomy(
    seqtab, reference_path("GTDB_bac120_arc53_ssu_r220_fullTaxo.fa.gz"),
    minBoot = min_boot, multithread = threads
  )
  saveRDS(gtdb_taxa, gtdb_cache)
}
invisible(gc(full = TRUE))

asv_ids <- sprintf("ASV%04d", seq_along(sequences))
names(asv_ids) <- sequences

tidy_taxonomy <- function(tax, source) {
  out <- as.data.frame(tax, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  out$asv_id <- asv_ids[rownames(out)]
  out$sequence <- rownames(out)
  out$reference <- source
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out[, c("asv_id", "reference", setdiff(names(out), c("asv_id", "reference", "sequence")), "sequence")]
}

silva_table <- tidy_taxonomy(silva_taxa, "silva_138.2")
gtdb_table <- if (is.null(gtdb_taxa)) NULL else tidy_taxonomy(gtdb_taxa, "gtdb_r220")

boot_table <- as.data.frame(silva_boot, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
boot_table$asv_id <- asv_ids[rownames(boot_table)]
rownames(boot_table) <- NULL
boot_table <- boot_table[, c("asv_id", setdiff(names(boot_table), "asv_id"))]

# Read-weighted concordance per rank. Unassigned on either side is reported
# separately from a genuine disagreement, because they mean different things.
abundance <- colSums(seqtab)
strip_prefix <- function(x) sub("^[a-z]__", "", x)
common_ranks <- if (is.null(gtdb_taxa)) character(0) else
  intersect(colnames(silva_taxa), colnames(gtdb_taxa))
concordance <- do.call(rbind, lapply(common_ranks, function(rank) {
  a <- strip_prefix(silva_taxa[sequences, rank])
  b <- strip_prefix(gtdb_taxa[sequences, rank])
  both <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b)
  agree <- both & a == b
  data.frame(
    rank = rank,
    asvs_total = length(sequences),
    asvs_assigned_silva = sum(!is.na(a)),
    asvs_assigned_gtdb = sum(!is.na(b)),
    asvs_comparable = sum(both),
    asvs_agreeing = sum(agree),
    asv_agreement_fraction = round(ifelse(sum(both) > 0, sum(agree) / sum(both), NA), 4),
    read_agreement_fraction = round(
      ifelse(sum(abundance[both]) > 0, sum(abundance[agree]) / sum(abundance[both]), NA), 4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

write.table(silva_table, file.path(output_dir, "16s_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
if (!is.null(gtdb_table)) {
  write.table(gtdb_table, file.path(output_dir, "16s_taxonomy_gtdb_r220.tsv"),
              sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
}
if (is.null(concordance)) {
  concordance <- data.frame(
    rank = NA_character_, asvs_total = length(sequences),
    asvs_assigned_silva = sum(!is.na(silva_taxa[sequences, "Genus"])),
    asvs_assigned_gtdb = NA_integer_, asvs_comparable = NA_integer_,
    asvs_agreeing = NA_integer_, asv_agreement_fraction = NA_real_,
    read_agreement_fraction = NA_real_,
    note = paste("GTDB r220 cross-check not run; SILVA 138.2 is the sole",
                 "assignment for this execution"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
write.table(boot_table, file.path(output_dir, "16s_taxonomy_silva_bootstraps.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
write.table(concordance, file.path(output_dir, "16s_taxonomy_concordance.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
saveRDS(list(silva = silva_taxa, silva_bootstraps = silva_boot, gtdb = gtdb_taxa,
             asv_ids = asv_ids),
        file.path(output_dir, "16s_taxonomy.rds"))

print(concordance)
cat(sprintf("\nWrote taxonomy tables to %s\n", output_dir))
cat("Report SILVA in the manuscript. Use GTDB only to state how far the 16S and MAG\n")
cat("naming systems agree; do not relabel SILVA assignments with GTDB names.\n")
```
